title: Core QoL (Quality of Life)
description: Mods to enjoy Minecraft more, without taking up so much of your time.
body:
QoL & Session Efficiency Mod

A mod focused on reducing session time with essential player quality-of-life changes:

v1.1

- Added recipe to the glass cutter: a stick and a diamond on the diagonal.

v1.0

- Auto-Harvest & Replant: Right-click crops (e.g., Cocoa Beans, Beetroot) with a hoe to instantly harvest and replant them. Note: Pumpkins and Melons are excluded.
- Area Clearing: Using a hoe on grass or flowers clears a 3x3 area instantly.
- No Trampling: Farmland no longer breaks when jumped or stepped on.
- Nether Wart Fortune: The Fortune enchantment applies when harvesting Nether Wart with a hoe via right-click.
- Fast Leaf Decay: Leaves disappear much faster once the tree trunk is removed.
- Glass Recovery: Glass blocks can be recovered by breaking them with a Glass Cutter.
- Instant Concrete: Right-clicking a water cauldron while holding Concrete Powder turns it into Concrete immediately.
- Dye Removal: Dyed leather armor pieces can be washed/bleached in a water cauldron.
- Cake Recovery: Shift + Right-click on an untouched cake to return it to your inventory.
- Potted Plant Retrieval: Shift + Right-click on a potted plant to return the flower to your inventory.
- Step Assist: Walk up full blocks as if they were slabs without jumping (disabled while sneaking).
- Slime Block Dampening: Holding SPACE while landing on a Slime Block prevents the bounce.
- Clock Utility: Right-click a Clock to display the time (24h format).
- Compass Utility: Right-click a Compass to display your current coordinates; click the coordinates in chat to copy them.
- Friendly Fire Protection: Owners can no longer deal damage to their own tamed pets.
- Chicken Shearing: Chickens can now be sheared for feathers.
- Silent Mobs: Naming a mob "Mute" with a Name Tag removes its sounds.
- Iron Golem Buff: Greatly increased healing amount when repairing Iron Golems with Iron Ingots.
- Invisible Item Frames: Right-click an Item Frame with a Glass Pane to make it invisible. Does not consume the pane; revert by breaking the frame.
- Guaranteed Shulker Drops: Shulkers will always drop 2 Shulker Shells upon death.
- Death Coordinates: The exact coordinates of your death are displayed in the chat.
